audience: retail and distribution teams that look up items and reserve stock on sales orders in Ginesys ERP

useCases.title: Look up an item's price and tax group
useCases.text: Look up one item by its item code or barcode. Read its prices, tax group, unit of measure and stock settings.

useCases.title: Create a sales order for item lines
useCases.text: Look up each item first to check its code. Then create a sales order with its item lines. Set your own order id, so a retry cannot make a duplicate.

useCases.title: Reserve stock for an existing order
useCases.text: Reserve stock for lines of an existing sales order at one site. Give the order code or your own order id to find the order.

useCases.title: Cancel part of a stock reservation
useCases.text: Cancel part or all of a stock reservation on sales order lines. Give the order code or your own order id to find the order.
